Sasha: Quick async standup — onboarding llama3-smallq.
Sasha: What I did:
- ran batch evals on promptset 'help_center_v2' (≈50k queries), observed ROUGE-L drop ~3% on summary tasks vs baseline.
- warmed KV-cache and smoke-tested prefix caching.
- opened PR #789 with quant config tweaks.
Sasha: Blockers:
- rerank tests failing in eval harness (4/120 failing), can't reproduce locally for Spanish subset — tokenization mismatch?
- CI runtime slightly noisier (+12ms avg latency) after recent runtime change.
Sasha: Today:
- triage rerank failures, collect failing examples, run seed sweep.
- ping @kevin for PR review, push small fix if needed.

Ravi: can you paste the eval command + seed you used?
Sasha: ```
python scripts/eval.py --model llama3-smallq --prompts help_center_v2 --seed 42 --batch 8 --out out.json
```

Marta: I can take the tokenizer diff; which tokenizer version are you using?
Sasha: Using sentencepiece v0.2.9 locally. CI logs show tokenizers v0.3.1.
Marta: ok likely mismatch. Send a failing example.
Sasha: example:
Input: '¿Cómo restablezco mi contraseña?'
Expected: 'Para restablecer...'
Actual: 'Para restablecer mi contraseña?' (note missing accent normalization)

qc-bot: Eval Bot: rerank-tests: 4 failed / 120 | avg latency +12ms | median p50 78ms -> 90ms | logs: https://ci.internal/reports/3500001234

Evan: I can look at the rerank harness; last runtime change toggled beam-width default from 4->5 for sampling. Might affect candidate order.
Evan: @Kevin FYI — could affect your batch change.

Kevin: On it, will review PR #789 this afternoon. Also, I disabled global-batching in staging yesterday; that could shift latency patterns.

Marta: running tokenizer diff now; preliminary shows vocab mismatch and an extra bos token in pretokenizer. Try pip install tokenizers==0.4.2 and rerun.

Sasha: thanks — will re-run with tokenizers 0.4.2 and update with new eval output. I'll also collect the 4 failing rerank examples and paste here.

Sasha: TL;DR: triaging rerank failures + tokenizer mismatch. Putting a hold on canary rollout until we confirm fix; will update thread by EOD.
